Run scTenifoldKnk in-silico knockout analysis

Source: R/scTenifold.R
RunScTenifoldKnk.Rd

Run the official scTenifoldKnk 2.0 workflow, including quality control, CPM normalization, network construction and perturbation analysis. Retain the upstream results in a Seurat object for scTenifoldKnkPlot.

Usage

RunscTenifoldKnk(
  object,
  gKO = NULL,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = "counts",
  features = NULL,
  qc = TRUE,
  qc_mt_threshold = 0.1,
  qc_min_library_size = 1000,
  qc_min_pct = 0.05,
  qc_remove_outlier_cells = TRUE,
  nc_lambda = 0,
  nc_nNet = 10,
  nc_nCells = 500,
  nc_nComp = 3,
  nc_scaleScores = TRUE,
  nc_symmetric = FALSE,
  nc_q = 0.9,
  td_K = 3,
  td_maxIter = 1000,
  td_maxError = 1e-05,
  td_nDecimal = 3,
  ma_nDim = 2,
  cores = 1,
  store_networks = TRUE,
  store_manifold = TRUE,
  tool_name = "scTenifoldKnk",
  verbose = TRUE,
  srt = NULL,
  nc_priorNetwork = NULL,
  ma_method = NULL,
  ma_heatT = 10,
  dr_empiricalNull = FALSE,
  dr_direction = TRUE,
  dr_directionT = 5,
  dr_directionRegressLibSize = FALSE,
  transcriptomeWide = FALSE,
  seed = 1
)

Arguments

object

A Seurat object.

gKO

Gene symbols to knock out together. In transcriptome-wide mode, each gene is knocked out separately; NULL selects all retained genes.

assay

Assay to use. NULL uses the default assay.

layer

Assay layer containing raw counts.

features

Optional genes to retain before the upstream workflow. Requested knockout genes are retained when present in the assay.

qc

Whether to apply upstream quality control.

qc_mt_threshold

Maximum mitochondrial read fraction.

qc_min_library_size

Minimum cell library size.

qc_min_pct

Minimum fraction of retained cells expressing a gene. The upstream filter retains genes strictly above this fraction.

qc_remove_outlier_cells

Whether to remove library-size outliers.

nc_lambda, nc_nNet, nc_nCells, nc_nComp, nc_scaleScores, nc_symmetric, nc_q, nc_priorNetwork

Network construction parameters passed to scTenifoldKnk::scTenifoldKnk().

td_K, td_maxIter, td_maxError, td_nDecimal

Tensor decomposition parameters passed to the upstream workflow.

ma_nDim

Number of manifold-alignment dimensions.

cores

Number of cores passed upstream as nCores.

store_networks

Whether to retain the upstream WT network.

store_manifold

Whether to retain manifold-alignment coordinates.

tool_name

Name of the object@tools entry.

verbose

Whether to print the message. Default is TRUE.

srt

Deprecated alias for object; supply exactly one of the two. It will be removed in scop 1.0.0.

ma_method

Comparison method: "manifold" or "heat". With NULL, upstream uses manifold alignment for single or joint knockouts and heat alignment for transcriptome-wide screens. The two methods produce different distances; heat alignment has no manifold coordinates to plot.

ma_heatT

Diffusion time for heat alignment.

dr_empiricalNull

Whether to use Efron's empirical null; requires locfdr.

dr_direction

Whether to include predicted response directions.

dr_directionT

Diffusion time for direction prediction.

dr_directionRegressLibSize

Whether to regress library size out of the expression used for direction prediction.

transcriptomeWide

Whether to knock out each target gene separately.

seed

Random seed passed upstream. NULL uses the caller's RNG; otherwise the upstream workflow restores the caller's RNG state.

Value

A Seurat object with the upstream result, parameters and package version stored in object@tools[[tool_name]]. Single and joint knockouts also expose diffRegulation directly in that entry.

Details

Requires scTenifoldKnk 2.0.0 or later. The former backend parameter and qc_min_cells count threshold have been removed; use qc_min_pct for upstream gene filtering. QC and statistical results can differ from earlier scop runs. Response directions are predictions, not measured expression changes. Transcriptome-wide matrices are retained in result; the existing plots visualize single or joint knockout differential-regulation tables.

Examples

data(pancreas_sub)
counts <- GetAssayData5(pancreas_sub, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
detected <- names(sort(Matrix::rowSums(counts > 0), decreasing = TRUE))
pancreas_sub <- RunscTenifoldKnk(
  pancreas_sub,
  gKO = "Pdx1",
  features = head(detected, 300),
  qc = FALSE,
  nc_nNet = 3,
  nc_nCells = 200,
  td_maxIter = 200,
  store_networks = TRUE,
  seed = 1
)
